local function addField(f)
	local n = f.Width * f.Depth
	local folder = f.StyleFolder == "Contract" and contractStyles or nil
	local fd = {def = f, style = getStyle(f.Style or "Starter", folder), phases = table.create(n, SF.MaxPhase), hp = table.create(n, 100),

	fd.maxX, fd.maxZ = o.X + f.Width * TS, o.Z + f.Depth * TS
	fields[f.Id] = fd
	return fd
end
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do addField(f) end

task.spawn(function()

	if not folder then return end
	local function added(c)
		if not c:IsA("Configuration") or c:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= player.UserId then return end
		local a = c:GetAttributes()
		if not (a.Id and a.Width and a.Depth and a.Center) or fields[a.Id] then return end
		addField(a)
	end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(added)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
		local fd = fields[c.Name]
		if fd and fd.def.OwnerUserId then destroyVisual(fd); fields[c.Name] = nil end
	end)
	for _, c in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do added(c) end
